```markdown
# SPACE INVADERS — AAA Retro-Futurism Reimagining
## Architectural Plan (v1.0)

> Classic 1978 grid-shooter rebuilt as a neon corridor defense: you pilot a hover-ship
> at the near end of a fog-drenched arena; an 11×5 formation of procedural drones
> marches across the far field and steps toward your line with every wall bounce.
> All rules are faithful to the original (scoring, speed curve, bullet caps, bunkers,
> mystery ship); all presentation is modern PBR + bloom + trauma-shake + time dilation.

---

## 1 · CORE GAMEPLAY — MATHEMATICAL MODEL

### 1.1 World & Coordinate Convention
- Playfield is the **XZ plane** (floor), Y = hover height. Camera at `(0, 13.5, 34)`,
  perspective 50°, looking down-corridor toward `z ≈ -12`. "Down-screen" in the classic
  maps to **+Z (toward player)**; "up-screen" maps to **−Z (far field)**.
- Player: fixed `z = +16`, moves along X only, `x ∈ [−19, +19]` (classic single-axis control).
- Formation grid: 11 columns × 5 rows. Columns span X at spacing 3.0 → `x_c = −15 … +15`.
  Rows are depth lines: `z_r = {−8, −10, −12, −14, −16}` (row 0 nearest player).
- Row → type → points (classic values): row 3,4 farthest = **Squid 30**; rows 1,2 =
  **Octopus 20**; rows 0… wait — classic: TOP row squid. Top of screen = farthest Z. So:
  `z=−16 → Squid(30)`, `z=−14,−12 → Octopus(20)`, `z=−10,−8 → Crab(10)`.

### 1.2 Formation Motion (the signature mechanic)
Continuous X-march + discrete Z step-down on wall contact — the exact classic behavior:

```
aliveRatio = alive / 55                          // 1 → 0
vX         = lerp(9, 84, pow(1 − aliveRatio, 1.6))   // u/s; last alien is frantic (classic feel)
direction  ∈ {+1, −1}

each step: x += direction · VX · dt
edge hit when maxLiveX·dir + dir·rAlien ≥ X_BOUND (=20):
    direction = −direction
    z_all   += STEP_DOWN (=1.05)                  // one row-step toward the player line
```
- **Loss condition:** any live alien `z ≥ PLAYER_Z − 3` (crosses the defense line).
- The speed curve is monotonic in kills — verified property: d(vX)/d(kills) > 0 ∀, so the
  game can never slow down mid-wave. Late-game `vX ≈ 84 u/s` with step-downs produces the
  classic "swarm rushing you" panic state.

### 1.3 Player Ship
- Speed 27 u/s keyboard (constant), gamepad: `x = axis · 27` with deadzone 0.18,
  smoothstep-shaped for fine control. Position clamped to `[−19, +19]`.
- Fire: **max 1 player bullet live** (classic constraint) AND cooldown 0.34 s — both must pass.
- Hitbox: circle r = 1.15 in XZ (generous vs visual hull ~2.6 wide → fair arcade feel).

### 1.4 Bullets & Collision (swept, tunneling-proof)
- Player bullet: `v = −70 ẑ`, lifetime until `z < −20`. Alien bullet: `v = +38…58 ẑ` (wave-scaled), cap **3 live** (classic).
- All bullet-vs-target tests are **segment–circle in XZ**: closest point on segment
  `[p₀, p₁]` to target center; hit if `d < rTarget + rBullet`. With max speed 70 u/s at
  120 Hz sim → travel per step ≤ 0.58 u < smallest radius sum (≈1.6) — no tunneling even without the sweep, but the sweep is kept as a correctness guarantee.
- Bullet vs bunker: same sweep against each live block cell-center within an AABB broadphase of the segment; crater radius 1.15 erodes all cells whose centers fall inside (classic "bite" shape).

### 1.5 Alien Fire Control
```
fireRate λ = lerp(0.7, 4.2, pow(1 − aliveRatio, 1.3))   // shots/s, wave-scaled ×(1 + 0.15·wave)
on fire: pick random column c with ≥1 survivor; spawn from lowest (max z) live alien in c
```
Expected time-to-first-hit stays bounded because bullets are aimed straight down-column —
the player must move to dodge, exactly as designed in 1978.

### 1.6 Bunkers (destructible cover)
- 4 bunkers at `x ∈ {−12, −4, +4, +12}`, `z = +7` (between player and formation).
- Each: 13 × 7 cell grid, cell 0.42 u, arch cutout → ≈ 80 live cells; **all 4 bunkers share ONE InstancedMesh (≤ 330 instances)** — one draw call for all cover.
- Erosion is symmetric: player bullets and alien bullets both carve craters of r = 1.15.
- Dead cell → instance matrix scaled to 0 (no buffer rebuild, no allocation).

### 1.7 Mystery Ship (UFO)
- Spawns every `rand(20, 38)` s after an 8 s grace; flies `x: −24 → +24` at `z = −17, y = 6`, v = 9 u/s.
- Score on kill: weighted pick from {50:40%, 100:30%, 150:20%, 300:10%}. Warble audio while active.

### 1.8 Scoring, Lives, Waves
- Squid 30 · Octopus 20 · Crab 10 · UFO as above. **Extra life at every 10,000 pts** (classic).
- Modern multiplier: consecutive kills within a 4 s window raise ×1 → ×8 (cap); resets to ×1 on player hit. HUD shows the meter.
- Win a wave = all 55 dead → `WAVE_CLEAR` state (2.2 s celebration) → next wave with table below; score persists.
- Loss = defense line crossed OR lives exhausted → `GAME_OVER`. Hi-score persisted to `localStorage['si_hiscore']` (runtime storage, not an asset file).

| param            | w=1   | +per wave        | cap     |
|------------------|-------|------------------|---------|
| VX multiplier    | 1.00  | ×(1+0.12·w)      | 2.2×    |
| fireRate mult    | 1.00  | ×(1+0.15·w)      | 3.0×    |
| alien bullet spd | 38    | +4 u/w           | 62      |

### 1.9 Determinism & Fairness
- Fixed **120 Hz simulation** via accumulator in `Engine`; render interpolates. All rules above are pure functions of `(state, dt)` → frame-rate independent, replay-consistent.

---

## 2 · MODERN ENHANCEMENTS (the 20 AAA upgrades)

| # | Upgrade | Exact Three.js / implementation |
|---|---------|---------------------------------|
| 1 | **PBR neon hulls** | `MeshStandardMaterial` everywhere: dark hulls `metalness .85 / roughness .32`, accent strips as separate emissive sub-materials. No basic/lambert materials anywhere in the scene graph. |
| 2 | **Tuned bloom pipeline** | `EffectComposer → RenderPass → UnrealBloomPass(strength 1.15, radius 0.6, threshold 0.82) → OutputPass`; renderer `ACESFilmicToneMapping`, exposure 1.05. Emissive discipline: only designated emitters exceed the 0.82 threshold (`emissiveIntensity` 2.2–4.5); hulls ≤ 0.35 → glow reads as light, never white-out. |
| 3 | **Trauma camera shake** | `CameraShake`: trauma ∈ [0,1], `add(impact)`, exponential decay τ = 0.9 s; per-frame offset = `trauma² · maxAmp · (sin/cos noise triad)` applied after base transform + FOV kick `+4°·trauma` on heavy hits. |
| 4 | **Hit-stop / time dilation** | `HitStop.trigger(duration, scale)` writes `Engine.timescale`; sim delta scaled, render/particles/shake run at full rate → world dilates while feedback stays crisp (standard action-game technique). |
| 5 | **Centralized particle system** | ONE `InstancedMesh` (unit box geo × standard mat), hard cap **500**, structure-of-arrays state (`Float32Array` pos/vel/life/color/priority), per-instance color + orientation; presets: sparks (velocity-aligned stretched boxes), explosion core, debris shards, glow motes. Priority eviction of oldest-lowest when over budget. |
| 6 | **Motion trails** | Pooled instanced light-streaks (12 segments/trail × 8 trails): per-frame ring buffer of positions → instance transforms with scale + `instanceColor` fade; used on player bullets, alien bullets late-wave, and the UFO. Fully MeshStandardMaterial-compliant glow via emissive. |
| 7 | **Shockwave rings** | Pooled thin tori (10), emissive; spawn with orientation context (`floor` for ground/bunker impacts, `billboard` for mid-air kills); scale 0→maxR over 0.45 s + opacity fade. |
| 8 | **Floating score text** | DOM pool of glassmorphism chips (backdrop-blur, neon border), projected 3D→2D per frame via camera, rise+fade 0.9 s; renders `"+60 ×4"` with multiplier color ramp. |
| 9 | **Dual input + rumble** | One polled `InputState` from keyboard (WASD/arrows) and Gamepad API (axes deadzone .18 smoothstep, RT/A fire); `vibrationActuator` pulses on hits/deaths where supported; pause/start edge-triggered. |
| 10 | **Synthesized audio** | WebAudio only: invader "march" arpeggio (square+saw, lookahead scheduler) whose tempo tracks alive-count — the iconic accelerating heartbeat; laser sweep, noise-burst explosions with lowpass sweep, UFO warble LFO, UI blips. Master gain → `DynamicsCompressor`. Lazy context unlock on first gesture. |
| 11 | **Procedural grid floor** | Canvas-generated 512² neon-grid texture (line lattice + radial fade) as map+emissiveMap on a 140×90 plane; `FogExp2(0x05060f, 0.016)` for corridor depth cueing. Zero image files. |
| 12 | **Alien animation frames** | Each of the 3 types built as merged low-poly silhouettes (BufferGeometry + `mergeGeometries`) in **two hand-built frames**; formation swaps frame A/B on each step tick — faithful 2-frame march, zero runtime cost. |
| 13 | **Instanced bunkers** | All cover = one InstancedMesh; erosion via boolean grids + zero-scale matrices (see §1.6). |
| 14 | **Mystery ship setpiece** | Pooled UFO with warble audio, long trail, triple shockwave + hit-stop on kill — the wave's punctuation mark. |
| 15 | **Wave difficulty curve** | Parameter table (§1.8) applied at wave start; formation re-spawns full grid each wave. |
| 16 | **Multiplier combo meter** | Kill-chain timer in Game state; HUD bar fills toward next tier, color ramps cyan→magenta at ×4+. |
| 17 | **Glassmorphism HUD & screens** | Score / hi-score / lives (ship glyphs) / wave / multiplier; menu, pause, wave-clear, game-over overlays with `backdrop-filter: blur(18px)` panels, neon borders, CSS scanline + vignette layers. |
| 18 | **Impact flash layer** | DOM full-screen radial flash on player hit (opacity pulse) layered under HUD — cheap screen feedback without an extra composer pass. |
| 19 | **Fixed-timestep core** | 120 Hz accumulator, interpolation alpha to render; all collision math in XZ with swept tests (§1.4). |
| 20 | **Memory hygiene contract** | Every GPU resource has one owner that disposes it; `Engine.teardown()` runs registered disposers in reverse construction order; hot loop is allocation-free (preallocated temp vectors, SoA particle state, pools for every dynamic object). |

## 3 · GRAPHICS PIPELINE

### 3.1 Render stack
```
WebGLRenderer(antialias, pixelRatio ≤ 2)
  outputColorSpace = SRGB · toneMapping = ACESFilmic · exposure = 1.05
EffectComposer
 ├─ RenderPass(scene, camera)
 ├─ UnrealBloomPass(res, strength 1.15, radius 0.6, threshold 0.82)
 └─ OutputPass()                      // tone-map + sRGB in one pass
```
Resize: `composer.setSize` + bloom resolution update on container ResizeObserver.

### 3.2 Lighting rig (PBR interest without cost)
- Ambient `0x2a3550 @ .55` · key directional `0xbfd4ff @ .8` from above-behind camera
- Rim point lights: magenta `(−18, 6, −14)` and cyan `(+18, 6, −14)`, distance-falloff — gives hulls two-tone neon reflections.
- One subtle follow-light offset behind the player ship (intensity .35).

### 3.3 Emissive budget table (bloom discipline)
| Surface | emissiveIntensity | crosses threshold? |
|---|---|---|
| Alien cores / eye strips | 2.6–4.0 | ✔ glow |
| Bullet tips, UFO lights | 3.5 | ✔ |
| Ring edges, particle sparks | 3.0 (× instanceColor) | ✔ |
| Floor grid lines | 1.6 on near-black base | partial — only bright lattice glows softly |
| Hulls, bunker blocks | ≤ 0.35 | ✘ stays PBR-lit |

### 3.4 Procedural generation math (no asset files)
- **Alien silhouettes:** parametric BufferGeometry per type/frame — Squid: cone body + 6 leg boxes (frame B = legs retracted, body squashed 0.92); Octopus: boxy hull + 4 tentacle boxes alternating; Crab: wide trapezoid hull + eye bar. All merged via `mergeGeometries`, flat normals for crisp retro reads under PBR.
- **Player ship:** swept-wing low-poly (extruded profile + canopy), thruster cone with emissive core that pulses at 8 Hz while moving.
- **Grid floor texture:** 512² canvas — black base, lattice lines `rgba(0,240,255,.9)` every 32 px, major lines every 128 px brighter, radial gradient fade to transparent edges; used as map + emissiveMap (emissive color cyan).
- **Bunker blocks:** single box geometry shared by the InstancedMesh; per-instance slight hue jitter via `instanceColor` (cyan→teal band) for organic read.

---

## 4 · VFX PRIORITY LOGIC

### 4.1 Particle budget arbitration (hard cap 500, centralized)
| Priority | Event | Count | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| P3 (never evicted) | Player death explosion | 90 | reserved feel: eviction skips P3 slots |
| P2 | Alien kill burst / UFO kill | 26–40 | UFO = 40 + ring×3 |
| P1 | Bunker erosion chips | 8 per eroded cluster | suppressed if active > 420 |
| P0 (first evicted) | Thruster motes, ambient sparks | 2–4/frame | auto-suppressed above 420 active |

Eviction rule: over-capacity spawn replaces the **lowest-priority oldest** slot.
Budget guard: `activeCount > 420` → P0 spawns dropped silently (no allocation attempt).

### 4.2 Camera shake — trauma sources & amounts
| Event | trauma added | notes |
|---|---|---|
| Player hit by alien bullet | **1.0** | + FOV kick, + impact flash, + hit-stop |
| UFO kill | 0.8 | heavy setpiece |
| Alien kill | 0.22 + 0.05·multiplier | micro-shake only |
| Bunker erosion (per cluster) | 0.15 | capped at .6 total per frame |
| Wave clear | 0.45 | "positive" shake — celebratory, paired with hit-stop breath |

Decay: `trauma *= exp(−dt/0.9)`; offset amplitude = `trauma² · 1.35 u` (quadratic → quiet at low trauma, violent only on real impacts).

### 4.3 Hit-stop — trigger table (deliberately sparse)
| Event | duration | timescale | rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| Player hit | **90 ms** | 0.12 | maximum weight — the moment that costs a life |
| UFO kill | 70 ms | 0.20 | setpiece punctuation |
| Wave clear | 50 ms | 0.30 | "breath" before next wave |

Small alien kills get **no** hit-stop (would feel mushy at 10+ kills/s late game) — they get micro-shake + particles instead. Overlapping triggers: strongest scale wins, longest remaining duration retained; restore to 1.0 in real-time after expiry.

### 4.4 Frame-order contract (per fixed step)
```
input.poll → state.update(dt·timescale)   [movement, bullets, formation, fire]
→ collision resolution (swept tests)      [kills, erosion, hits — emit events]
→ VFX event dispatch                      [particles, rings, shake.add, hitstop, audio, score text]
→ ParticleManager.update(dt real-time)    // particles run at full rate even during hit-stop
→ CameraShake.update/apply                // same: full-rate feedback
```

### 5.2 Import graph (every edge resolves to a real export)
```
main.js            → shared/core/Engine, Space_Invaders/index
Space_Invaders/index.js → Game, config, shared/{core/InputController, vfx/*, audio/AudioEngine}
Game.js            → entities/*, config, shared/utils/math

Engine             → PostPipeline, InputController(owned by Game — Engine stays input-agnostic)
```
**Ownership rule:** a module that allocates GPU resources owns its disposal and registers it with
`Engine.registerDisposer`. `Game` is the only orchestrator of VFX events; entities are dumb about
presentation. No circular imports: shared/* never imports Space_Invaders/*.

### 5.3 Edge cases handled by design
- **Tunneling:** swept segment–circle tests (§1.4) — bullet can't skip a target at any frame rate.
- **Sim/render divergence during hit-stop:** particles/shake/audio run real-time; only world state dilates.
- **Gamepad disconnect mid-game:** input falls back to keyboard seamlessly (state is merged, not sourced).
- **Audio context blocked before gesture:** all audio no-ops until first key/press unlocks it; march starts on PLAYING entry.
- **Tab hidden:** RAF pauses → accumulator clamps `frameTime ≤ 100 ms` so the sim never explodes on return.
- **Double-dispose safety:** dispose registry tracks disposed resources; teardown idempotent.
- **Wave transition races:** state machine gates all input/fire during WAVE_CLEAR/GAME_OVER; pools fully released between waves (bunkers rebuilt, bullets culled).
```
